name: Kishoreganj
registryBasis: The official Kishoreganj Sadar Upazila Land Office identifies the local land administration. The official DLRS site assigns Kishoreganj to its Mymensingh settlement zone, and DLRS Map Search exposes district, survey, upazila, mouza, and sheet selectors. Its public selector returned Kishoreganj district, but no survey options for that district.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public DLRS map UI has an advertised GeoJSON sheet route and parcel vector-tile route after a survey/mouza selection. The district selector resolved Kishoreganj (`010400000`), but the corresponding public survey selector returned HTTP 200 with an empty list. No sheet or parcel tile can therefore be selected for Kishoreganj through this route without inventing codes. The owner/khatian detail endpoint was not called.
scopeLimits: Inspected the public DLRS map-search HTML and client script, queried only division/district/survey administrative selectors, and verified the Kishoreganj Sadar local land office. Did not request a plot/dag, khatian, owner, land area, legal identifier, or map feature record. The map’s separate Khatian-data endpoint is excluded.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the district survey selector is temporarily empty, whether a current BDS or other survey map is served through a different official route, and whether any selected mouza sheet covers the WUP center or the broader Kishoreganj Sadar urban area.
